text.content:
Passages fork here into the Gilded heart of the Cisterns, worn smooth by traffic that wasn't always living.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: A formula for a rogue homunculus conclave to end all suffering - or all resistance - was hidden in the Cisterns below, and someone just found the first ingredient.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 15 to detect and counter).
